description: XTEINK X4 Pro Developer Edition — ESP32-S3R8, 16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM, e-paper UC8279 800x480, touch GT911, RTC BM8563, gauge CW2017. Full bring-up: docs/hardware-specs.md

offsets._comment_bootloader: S3 = 0x0 (not 0x1000 like ESP32 classic — a documented trap: flashing at 0x1000 causes a boot loop with an invalid header).

console.port_hint: native USB-Serial/JTAG via the pogo dock (COMx)
